title: Covectors with the coefficient norm form a Euclidean space
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there are d ∈ ℕ and a continuous linear equivalence c from the space of n-covectors on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) n, with its operator-norm topology) onto ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) such that covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c(α)‖ for every n-covector α. Here covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_I)²)^{1/2}, with e_I = (e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)}) for the standard basis e of ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ (d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖
